evals.expected_output: The /fix pipeline runs end-to-end on a real milestone-3 bug (cosmetic credential-form 'or' divider): issue fetched with comments, PRE_FIX_SHA captured, new branch fix/issue-243, /tdd red-green regression test, commit referencing #243, /review with REVIEW_BASE=PRE_FIX_SHA and AXES=both, draft PR opened against milestone-3 containing Closes #243 and verbatim REVIEW_NOTES under ### Review notes.

assertions.name: issue-comments-fetched-as-spec
assertions.description: The run fetched issue #243's body AND all comments (the Agent Brief comment is part of the spec) per docs/agents/issue-tracker.md

assertions.name: pre-fix-sha-captured-before-work
assertions.description: git rev-parse HEAD was captured as PRE_FIX_SHA before any fix commit landed, and /review later used it as REVIEW_BASE

assertions.name: fix-branch-per-convention
assertions.description: A new branch fix/issue-243 was cut from milestone-3 (no open PR existed on milestone-3)

assertions.name: tdd-red-green-followed
assertions.description: The /tdd skill loop ran: a failing regression test reproducing the bug was written before the fix, then the minimal fix made it pass

assertions.name: regression-test-covers-acceptance
assertions.description: The regression test asserts Server URL is visually outside the username+password OR API key choice scope (the acceptance criterion from the Agent Brief)

assertions.name: verification-command-green
assertions.description: dotnet test "SwInventreeAddin.Tests/SwInventreeAddin.Tests.csproj" --disable-build-servers passed on the fix commit

assertions.name: review-ran-with-correct-inputs
assertions.description: /review ran with REVIEW_BASE=PRE_FIX_SHA, SPEC_SOURCE=the stored fix spec (body+comments), AXES=both, and returned clean/resolved/deferred (or escalated/capped with user consultation recorded)

assertions.name: draft-pr-with-review-notes
assertions.description: A draft PR opened against milestone-3 containing Closes #243, a one-line root cause + regression test note, build/test commands, ### Review notes with verbatim REVIEW_NOTES, and the /qa handoff line

assertions.name: scope-respected
assertions.description: Credential precedence/validation logic unchanged, configured-state card toolbar (#240) untouched, no out-of-scope edits
